_meta.indication: In combination with fulvestrant for the treatment of postmenopausal women, and men, with HR-positive, HER2-negative, PIK3CA-mutated, advanced or metastatic breast cancer as detected by an FDA-approved test following progression on or after an endocrine-based regimen.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, international multicenter trial of alpelisib plus fulvestrant versus placebo plus fulvestrant; subjects randomized 1:1 within PIK3CA mutant and non-mutant cohorts.
pivotal_trials.population: Postmenopausal women and men with HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced or metastatic breast cancer whose disease had progressed or recurred on or after an aromatase inhibitor, with or without a CDK 4/6 inhibitor.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Progression-free survival (PFS) by investigator assessment in the PIK3CA-mutant intention-to-treat population.
pivotal_trials.n: 572 patients total; PIK3CA-mutant cohort: 169 (alpelisib plus fulvestrant) and 172 (placebo plus fulvestrant).
pivotal_trials.result: In the PIK3CA-mutant cohort, median PFS was 11.0 months (95% CI 7.5, 14.5) with alpelisib plus fulvestrant vs 5.7 months (95% CI 3.7, 7.4) with placebo plus fulvestrant; HR 0.65 (95% CI 0.50, 0.85); p=0.0013. ORR 35.7% vs 16.2%.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions including lab abnormalities (all grades, incidence >=20%) were glucose increased, creatinine increased, diarrhea, rash, lymphocyte count decreased, GGT increased, nausea, ALT increased, and fatigue. Serious risks include severe hypersensitivity (including anaphylaxis), severe cutaneous reactions (SJS/EM), hyperglycemia, pneumonitis, and diarrhea. Grade 3 diarrhea occurred in 7% of patients.
target_moa: Alpelisib is an alpha-specific class I phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase (PI3K) inhibitor; gain-of-function PIK3CA mutations activate PI3K-alpha and Akt-signaling driving cellular transformation and tumorigenesis.
companion_dx_detail: Patient selection based on PIK3CA mutations detected by an FDA-approved test; in SOLAR-1 PIK3CA mutations were confirmed using the therascreen PIK3CA RGQ PCR Kit.

requirement.text: Submit the final overall survival (OS) analysis and datasets with the final report from the ongoing clinical trial BYL719C2301 (SOLAR-1).

citations.quote: 3573-1 Submit the final overall survival (OS) analysis and datasets with the final report from the ongoing clinical trial BYL719C2301, SOLAR-1, entitled "A Phase III randomized double-blind, placebo controlled study of alpelisib in combination with fulvestrant for men and postmenopausal women with hormone receptor positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer with progression on or after aromatase inhibitor treatment".

requirement.text: Conduct a clinical trial to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of a strong CYP3A4 inducer on the pharmacokinetics of alpelisib and to determine appropriate dosing recommendations.

citations.quote: 3573-2 Conduct a clinical trial to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of a strong CYP3A4 inducer on pharmacokinetics of alpelisib to assess the magnitude of decreased alpelisib exposure and to determine appropriate dosing recommendations. Design and conduct the trial in accordance with the FDA Guidance for Industry; "Clinical Drug Interaction Studies - Study Design, Data Analysis, and Clinical Implications."

requirement.text: Conduct a clinical trial to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of alpelisib on the single-dose PK of sensitive probe substrates of CYP2B6, CYP3A4 and CYP2C-family enzymes (CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and/or CYP2C8).

citations.quote: 3573-3 Conduct a clinical trial to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of alpelisib on the single dose pharmacokinetics of sensitive probe substrates to assess the magnitude of exposure change for sensitive substrates of CYP2B6, CYP3A4 and CYP2C-family enzymes (CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and/or CYP2C8) and to determine appropriate dosing recommendations.
